pg_21__page_7_Diagram_4.jpeg.description: A directed graph showing a binary relation $R^*$ defined on a 5-element set $\Omega = \{a, b, c, d, e\}$ arranged in a pentagonal layout. The directed edges (arrows) represent pairs $(x, y) \in R^*$ (i.e., $x$ beats $y$): $a \rightarrow b$, $a \rightarrow c$, $b \rightarrow c$, $b \rightarrow d$, $c \rightarrow d$, $c \rightarrow e$, $d \rightarrow a$, $d \rightarrow e$, $e \rightarrow a$, and $e \rightarrow b$. Each element has exactly two outgoing arrows.
